file_bounds: regular files only; 256 MiB maximum with growth-limited reads; sparse oversized-file and directory rejection tested
host_cli_assertions: original record; nonexistent -X retains original; changed ignored record reports 2.0.0; malformed/truncated/oversized/trailing frames panic explicitly
negative_controls: both CPUs: binary record mutations (duplicate asserted in allowed rodata), oversized section, hash-first OS/GOARCH/revision setting mutations, wrong expected version/revision/CPU/hash; ELF rejection; missing VCS; dirty source; writable marker; host CLI framing failures
signature_verification: not implemented or tested; harness-computed digest provides no authenticity
